candidates.title: Accelerating long-context inference of large language models via dynamic attention load balancing
candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance across various natural language processing tasks. However, their quadratic complexity of attention mechanisms results in ineﬃciency during long-context inference. Although existing research has employed sparse attention techniques to enhance LLM eﬃciency in long-context scenarios, we observe that these methods introduce heterogeneous attention computation patterns across diﬀerent heads, leading to GPU load imbalance and resource idling during practical deployments. To address this challenge
candidates.reason: 長文LLM推論の疎注意におけるヘッド間GPU負荷不均衡を、ヘッド別プロファイリングと入力長に応じた配置戦略探索、重みの事前再配置、cross-prefetchで改善するFlexAttn。著者所属のメルボルン大学公開の査読誌原著PDFによれば、LLaMA3-8Bで160k〜768k文脈の長文推論throughputを34.95〜40.9%改善。RTX 3090の768k条件では2447.07対2023.25 tokens/s（20.95%増）も報告するが、比較条件が異なるため数字を混同しない。GPU4台・最大768k文脈等の適用範囲制約がある。

candidates.title: ATTS: Asynchronous Test-Time Scaling via Conformal Prediction
candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) benefit from test-time scaling but are often hampered by high inference latency. Speculative decoding is a natural way to accelerate the scaling process; however, scaling along both the parallel and sequential dimensions poses significant challenges, including substantial memory-bound execution and synchronization overhead. We introduce ATTS (Asynchronous Test-Time Scaling), a statistically guaranteed adaptive scaling framework that follows the hypothesis testing process to address these challenges. By revisiting arithmetic intensity, ATTS identifies synchronization as the primary bottleneck. It enables asynchronous inference through online calibration and proposes an ordinal classification algorithm that supports a three-stage rejection sampling pipeline, scaling along both the sequential and parallel axes. Across experiments on the MATH, AMC23, AIME24, and AIME25 datasets and across multiple draft-target model families, we show that ATTS delivers up to 56.7x speedup in test-time scaling and a 4.14x throughput improvement, while maintaining accurate control of the rejection rate, reducing latency and memory overhead, and incurring no accuracy loss. By scaling both in parallel and sequential dimensions, we enable the 1.5B/70B draft/target model combination to achieve the performance of the state-of-the-art reasoning model o3-mini (high) on the AIME dataset. We have released the code at https://github.com/menik1126/asynchronous-test-time-scaling.
candidates.reason: LLM推論時スケーリングの同期・メモリ負担を削減する直接的な効率化研究。ICLR 2026公式一次要旨では、オンライン較正と仮説検定に基づく非同期の3段階rejection samplingで並列・逐次両軸のtest-time scalingを扱い、MATH/AMC23/AIME24/AIME25等で最大56.7倍のtest-time scaling高速化と4.14倍のthroughput改善を報告。比較基準・モデル条件を限定した最大値であり、通常の単一要求の推論速度を56.7倍にするとの意味ではない。WORKLISTのA1は改題前タイトルで、ICLR 2026ではATTSとして掲載。
